messages:
omar: Sentry picked up a log that includes an AWS KMS key ARN and a truncated ciphertext header from the secrets-sync service in staging. not raw secret, but assume sensitive.

celia: paste the log snippet and which host/pod emitted it?

omar: redacted: 
```
ERROR secrets-sync: decrypt failed for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7g8h-9i0j-kmsid: ciphertext=AQICAHj...XYZ
```
service: secrets-sync-7b6f in staging.

frank: That ARN plus ciphertext header is enough for us to treat it like a leak. It could point an attacker to a key with weaker protections. Plan: 1) snapshot audit trails (AWS CloudTrail + GCP Audit for cross-check), 2) temporarily revoke KMS decrypt for the service principal in both clouds, 3) rotate relevant keys, 4) re-encrypt artifacts encrypted with the old key, 5) scrub logs and push a logging-redaction change.

sec-oncall: Ack. I'll start exports: CloudTrail -> s3://sec-audit-dumps/inc-3419999999/cloudtrail.tar.gz and GCP audit -> gs://sec-archives/inc-3419999999/gcp-audit.tar.gz. Will DM links when done.

logger-bot: creating short-lived alert rule to fire on regex matching 'arn:aws:kms:[^\s]+' and 'projects/.*/keyRings/.*cryptoKeys/.*' in indexed logs for 48h.

frank: immediate RBAC commands we should run (staging):

# AWS: remove decrypt permission from the role
aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name secrets-sync-role --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSKMSDecrypt

# GCP: remove decrypt role from backup SA (if it exists)
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding project-staging --member=serviceAccount:secrets-sync@project-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter

omar: running AWS detach now; will run gcloud after confirmation.

infra: ran a scan across buckets/objects: found ~8 S3 objects (s3://backups-staging/2026-04-02/) and 3 GCS objects (gs://backups/staging/2026-04-02/) whose metadata indicates they were encrypted with the identified ARN / key resource. Owners discovered via metadata.

celia: schedule for key rotation: For AWS KMS, we'll create a new KMS key (alias alias/secrets-sync-rot-3419), re-encrypt (copy with SSE-KMS using new key) and then schedule a disable of the old key after owners complete re-encryption. For GCP, rotate the cryptoKey and re-encrypt objects to new version.

vault-bot: Received request: schedule rotate for local transit key used by secrets-sync. Rotation started. audit_ref: vb-3419.

frank: sample re-encrypt workflow for S3 objects (owners):
```
NEW_KEY_ALIAS=alias/secrets-sync-rot-3419
for obj in $(aws s3api list-objects --bucket backups-staging --prefix "2026-04-02/" --query 'Contents[].Key' --output text); do
  aws s3 cp s3://backups-staging/$obj /tmp/$obj
  aws s3 cp /tmp/$obj s3://backups-staging/$obj --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id $NEW_KEY_ALIAS
  rm /tmp/$obj
done
```
And for GCS (owners):
```
gsutil cp gs://backups/staging/2026-04-02/<file> /tmp/
python tools/re_encrypt_gcs.py --in /tmp/<file> --out /tmp/<file>.new --kms-key projects/project-staging/locations/global/keyRings/redact/cryptoKeys/key-v2
gsutil cp /tmp/<file>.new gs://backups/staging/2026-04-02/<file>
```
(We will provide tested helper scripts in the incident ticket.)

sec-oncall: CloudTrail and GCP audit exports completed -> s3://sec-audit-dumps/inc-3419999999/cloudtrail.tar.gz and gs://sec-archives/inc-3419999999/gcp-audit.tar.gz. Preserved for 90d.

frank: after owners re-encrypt we'll rotate/disable the compromised key: AWS step: create key, re-encrypt objects, schedule_disable_key --pending-window 7 days (or disable immediately in staging if owners done). GCP: set new primary cryptoKeyVersion and revoke old IAM decrypt binding.

logger-bot: patch queued: redact_kms_paths = true in logging pipeline; regex: `s|(arn:aws:kms:[^\s]+)|(kms:<redacted>)|g` and `s|(projects/[^\s]+/keyRings/[^\s]+/cryptoKeys/[^:\s]+)|kms:<redacted>|g`. Will deploy hotfix to staging in 10m.

omar: partners were pinged; vendor says their endpoint only received job status updates. no object downloads on their side.

infra: owners notified via email + ticket INC-2026-0415-07 with re-encrypt instructions and 72h SLA. We enumerated owners and contact points in the ticket.

vault-bot: Local transit rotation complete. new version: 5. Audit log: audit/inc-3419999999/vault-rotate.log

frank: follow-ups: 1) confirm owners run re-encrypt scripts and mark objects as verified, 2) once verified, disable old keys (or schedule deletion per cloud policies), 3) run a retroactive log-scrub for indexed logs where possible, 4) update runbook to include cross-cloud KMS ARN leak handling, 5) postmortem tomorrow 09:30.

celia: filing incident INC-2026-0415-07 (sev3) now and attaching exports and timeline.

sec-oncall: Alert rule active for 48h. Will escalate if hits > 0.

omar: owners started re-encrypt; partner confirmed no exfil. Closing immediate mitigation checklist: audit snapshot -> RBAC revoke -> key create/rotate -> owner re-encrypt -> logging redact -> preserve audits. Follow-ups tracked in INC-2026-0415-07. :white_check_mark:
